name: simplex-noise-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Simplex Noise style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#101010, #F5F5F5, #B0B0B0, #3A3A3A). Features: cursor-reactive (push). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
